mapper.sql: s.id, s.session_no, s.user_id, s.subject_id, s.template_id, s.status, s.total_duration_sec, s.remaining_sec, s.current_sitting_no, s.current_section_no, s.question_count, s.objective_score, s.auto_scored_max_score, s.total_max_score, s.started_at, s.submitted_at, s.scored_at, s.created_at, s.updated_at
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO exam_session (session_no, user_id, subject_id, template_id, status, total_duration_sec, remaining_sec, current_sitting_no, current_section_no, question_count, objective_score, auto_scored_max_score, total_max_score, started_at) VALUES (#{sessionNo}, #{userId}, #{subjectId}, #{templateId}, #{status}, #{totalDurationSec}, #{remainingSec}, #{currentSittingNo}, #{currentSectionNo}, #{questionCount}, #{objectiveScore}, #{autoScoredMaxScore}, #{totalMaxScore}, #{startedAt})
mapper.select: SELECT FROM exam_session s WHERE s.user_id = #{userId} AND s.status IN ('CREATED', 'IN_PROGRESS') ORDER BY s.id DESC LIMIT 1
SELECT FROM exam_session s WHERE s.id = #{id} LIMIT 1
mapper.update: UPDATE exam_session SET status = #{status}, current_sitting_no = #{currentSittingNo}, current_section_no = #{currentSectionNo}, remaining_sec = #{remainingSec}, started_at = COALESCE(started_at, #{startedAt}) WHERE id = #{id}
UPDATE exam_session SET status = 'ABANDONED' WHERE id = #{id} AND status IN ('CREATED', 'IN_PROGRESS')
